classification_contract: Every baseline site is classified by the per-path counts below. Adapter conversions preserve the prior bound-owner result set. The one remaining ZAP creation expression is an exact-source named exception in owner_query_inventory.py because it correlates assessment and HTTP-profile ownership across tables; no conversion changes behavior in this branch.

result_set_contracts.connector_empty_personal: OAST and ZAP team requests match team_id; personal requests match session_id only when team_id is an empty string.
result_set_contracts.automation_null_or_empty_personal: Schedule, watcher, run-baseline, and notification requests match team_id in team scope or the legacy token/session owner with a NULL or empty team_id in personal scope.
result_set_contracts.unfiltered_token_migration: Notification-channel and event migration continues to replace the exact source token across personal and team rows without adding a team filter.
result_set_contracts.exact_event_key: Notification deduplication continues to match the exact token, team, channel, trigger, and run tuple.
result_set_contracts.unfiltered_watcher_run: Watcher diff loading continues to match the exact session and run id without adding a team predicate.
result_set_contracts.team_archive_mutation: Archived-team cleanup continues to affect only the supplied team and its exact watcher, schedule, or enabled-state keys.
result_set_contracts.named_exception: ZAP creation keeps its assessment-to-profile team and personal-owner correlations until Phase 3B.

coverage.list_detail: Notification channel and event reads, schedule and watcher lists and details, baseline-run selection, OAST correlations, and ZAP job history.
coverage.mutation: Channel and event writes, schedule and watcher updates, team archive pausing, OAST lifecycle changes, and ZAP import lifecycle transitions.
coverage.import_export: Notification token migration and ZAP-to-Atlas import linking retain their exact legacy owners; these subsystems have no separate owner-scoped export query.
coverage.cleanup_retention: Notification event retention, expired OAST cleanup, expired ZAP cleanup, and archived-team automation pausing retain their existing owner boundaries.
coverage.worker: Schedule dispatch, watcher finalization, notification delivery, OAST polling, and ZAP worker paths continue to use the existing session/token owner.
